title: See what a funded organisation gives its learners

steps.say: Tap **Courses** on the organisation's home page.
This is what the organisation hands out through its own sign-up page — given to each learner as they join, not held on the organisation itself.

The courses listed here, and the length of the free period beside them, come from the organisation's enrolment policy. Changing that list is a change to the policy, so it isn't editable here — everyone who has already signed up keeps what they were given.
steps.terminal: That's it — a read-only summary of what this organisation grants on sign-up.
